answer: By the gale of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, converted to a slow vesting stream, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The trellis is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the jade.
